input.evidence: Pinned command `python -m pytest tests/git_test.py` => 33 passed (was 32 baseline; new test included), exit 0. Verified in a scratch merge repo that adding `--` leaves the diff output unchanged in the no-collision case (`conflict_file extra_file` both before and after).
